actions.description: Initiate OAuth flow to connect a user's Gmail or Outlook inbox as a trigger source for quote detection.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/connect-trigger` — Kick off the Gmail/Outlook OAuth install. Body `{ provider: 'gmail'|'outlook' }`, response `{ install_url: string }`.

actions.description: Create a new automated reminder flow with user-defined steps and trigger type.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/create-flow` — Create a new flow. Body `{ name: string, trigger_type: string, steps: Step[] }`, response `{ flowId: string }`.

actions.description: Manually trigger a reminder flow for a specific quote, starting a new run.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/trigger-flow` — Manually fire a flow against a specific quote. Body `{ flowId: string, quoteSubject: string, recipientEmail: string }`, response `{ runId: string, status: 'queued' }`.

actions.description: Pause an in-progress run, e.g., when a customer replies manually.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/pause-run` — Pause an in-progress run. Body `{ runId: string }`, response `{ paused: true }`.

actions.description: Retry a failed step within a run, e.g., after an email bounce or rate limit.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/retry-step` — Retry a failed step within a run. Body `{ runId: string, stepIndex: number }`, response `{ retried: true }`.

actions.description: View a run and its steps, including timeline and status for each step.
actions.source_quote: API Route: `/api/view-run` — Read a run + its steps. Query `?runId=...`, response `{ run, steps }`.

actions.description: List all flows the user has created, including metadata and last-run status.
actions.source_quote: From PRD §Dashboard/flows: 'List of flows the user has created. Each row shows name, trigger type, last-run status, runs this week.'

actions.description: List all runs across all flows, with optional status filters.
actions.source_quote: From PRD §Dashboard/runs: 'All runs across all flows with status filter chips (in-progress, completed, paused, failed).'
